title: FlowLedger User Guide
intro: A clear daily routine for your Dashboard, Activity, Forecast, debt plan, savings, and Flo.

items.title: Dashboard
items.body: See where your money stands now.

items.title: Next up
items.body: Handle one useful next step at a time.

items.title: Activity
items.body: Review what changed in your accounts.

items.title: Forecast
items.body: Confirm what should happen next.

callout.title: FlowLedger plans—it does not send payments
callout.body: Continue paying bills and debts through your bank or provider.

title: Start with a complete plan
intro: Set up recurring money once, then review it whenever life changes.

items.title: Checking
items.body: Add the account used for everyday cash flow and enter its current balance.

items.title: Income
items.body: Add recurring income and confirm each expected payday.

items.title: Bills
items.body: Confirm amount, next date, and weekly, monthly, quarterly, or other frequency.

items.title: Debts
items.body: Enter the current balance, minimum payment, APR, and due date.

items.title: Savings
items.body: Add each account and give it a clear purpose name.

items.title: Forecast
items.body: Make sure the next two weeks look like real life.

callout.title: One shared plan
callout.body: Phone and website use the same household data and calculations. Only the layout changes.

title: Your daily 3-minute routine
intro: Use the same short path each day. Go deeper only when something changed or needs review.

items.title: 1. Dashboard
items.body: Check balance, pending outflows, available money, and Flow Score.

items.title: 2. Next up
items.body: Handle the few bills, debts, or choices that matter now.

items.title: 3. Activity
items.body: Review new transactions, matches, and anything needing attention.

items.title: 4. Forecast
items.body: Scan upcoming days and confirm each closing balance makes sense.

callout.title: If the day looks normal, you are done
callout.body: If something looks unfamiliar, open the related item before changing the plan.

title: Review Activity and match what happened
intro: Activity is the history of what really happened. Review new items before changing bills, balances, or the Forecast.

items.title: Check pending and posted
items.body: When bank sync is available, pending activity may change before it posts. Posted activity is part of your account history.

items.title: Match planned money
items.body: When imported activity is available, match it to the correct bill, debt payment, or income occurrence so it is counted once.

items.title: Resolve needs review
items.body: Confirm the category, transfer, duplicate, or forgotten plan item before dismissing it.

items.title: Use full amounts
items.body: Activity shows the full money amount. Open an item for its date, account, status, and history.

callout.title: One real event should appear once
callout.body: When bank sync is available, match a payment that is both planned and pending instead of creating a second bill or transaction.

title: Bills, debts, and planned payments
intro: Use Bills for recurring obligations and planned transfers between accounts. Switch to Debt to manage balances, minimums, or payoff order.

items.title: Keep the schedule current
items.body: Edit amount, next date, and frequency when they change.

items.title: Record manual payments
items.body: Mark a bill paid after you pay it outside FlowLedger.

items.title: Transfer between accounts
items.body: Choose Transfer when adding a bill, then pick From and To accounts, amount and schedule. Open the Transfers row in Bills to manage plans on their own page. For a monthly or one-time bill, Change to transfer preserves past history and replaces its future schedule after you confirm. Resolve any conflicting bill activity first.

items.title: Close finished items
items.body: Inactive bills should stop creating reminders and occurrences.

items.title: Review the order
items.body: See each lender’s original required minimum and the current snowball or avalanche target.

items.title: Check rollover
items.body: Rollover moves to the next debt as extra payoff money. It stays in Forecast but never makes the lender minimum larger or creates a false missed-payment alert.

items.title: Edit planned payments
items.body: Change an amount or date when it no longer fits real life.

items.title: Pause debt payments
items.body: Open a debt and choose Pause debt payments. Set start and resume dates, then choose Continue. At the final question, choose whether to move the payment to other debts in payoff order or keep it available. Redirecting requires Debt Payoff Plan to be on. The debt stays open in order and resumes automatically, or choose Resume now. Use Edit pause to change the resume date or payment choice. Scheduled pauses can also change their start date. Earlier pause history stays intact; changes apply going forward. This changes your FlowLedger plan only; lender payments and interest may still apply.

callout.title: Matched activity appears once
callout.body: Matching starts with the bank account’s plans and Unassigned items. Choose Include plans from other accounts when needed. The bank transaction keeps its original account.

title: Forecast and Plan Simulator
intro: Forecast shows when money should move and what each day's closing balance will be.

items.title: Choose an account
items.body: Connected bank accounts and manual accounts are listed separately. Choose an account and month for its own calendar and projected month end. Open Account details & plans for the recorded balance and upcoming activity.

items.title: Assign future plans
items.body: Use Assign accounts to open upcoming plans. Filter or search, then choose Paid from or Deposited to. For several plans, select them, choose an account, review, then save together. Unassigned plans stay in Household.

items.title: Show in Forecast menu
items.body: Open Settings > Household to show or hide an account in your Forecast menu. This personal preference changes the menu only; balances, Activity, matching, and plans stay included.

items.title: Open the day
items.body: Calendar cells show full whole-dollar amounts. Tap a date for exact cents and every item behind its closing balance.

items.title: Verify status
items.body: When bank sync is available, matched pending payments should appear once with their current status.

items.title: Sync is not cash activity
items.body: When bank sync is available, a refresh updates data but is not itself a calendar cash event.

items.title: Open Simulator
items.body: Free includes one current what-if draft. Test income, expenses, debt payments, a pause with a resume date, or a hypothetical new debt without changing your real plan.

items.title: Compare results
items.body: Use Calendar for daily balances and payments. Compare shows cash flow and payoff timing. Pauses may add interest and delay payoff. Pro and eligible Founders can save and compare scenarios.

items.title: Leave safely
items.body: Exit the simulator to return to the unchanged Forecast.

items.title: Plan account transfers
items.body: Open Bills > Transfers, then Plan transfer. Pick From and To accounts, amount, first date, Monthly or One time, and an optional last date. Review both sides, then save. No money moves and no Activity transactions are created.

items.title: Adjust a transfer date
items.body: Open its calendar date or Bills > Transfers to skip it or mark each side already included in its dated account balance. Pausing or deleting keeps a partly included date available. Reviewed dates keep their amount and accounts until you explicitly use the current plan.

callout.title: Best daily habit
callout.body: Before the day ends, confirm the next few closing balances match what you expect.

title: Savings and Flo
intro: Use savings for purpose-based balances. Use Flo for explanations and guided next steps.

items.title: Flip the full card
items.body: Tap Savings on Dashboard to switch from checking to savings.

items.title: Review accounts separately
items.body: Open Settings > Household for each manual or connected account’s current balance, available balance, and last update.

items.title: Rename your accounts
items.body: Choose Rename in Household or an account’s Forecast. Give checking, bills, cash, and savings accounts names you recognize.

items.title: Estimate savings interest
items.body: Open a Savings account’s forecast settings and enter its APY, then Save. The forecast adds estimated monthly interest. Leave APY blank if unknown. Estimates do not create Activity or change your bank balance; actual bank credits may differ.

items.title: Ask about a date
items.body: Flo Essentials gives local plan guidance. Free also includes ten conversational preview requests per calendar month, shared by the household.

items.title: Separate facts from forecasts
items.body: Flo calculates from recorded data. Expected paychecks and spending estimates are not guaranteed funds. Missing information is called out.

items.title: Full Flo
items.body: Pro includes 300 chat requests per calendar month per household and confirmed item creation. Eligible Founders keep their existing Flo access.

items.title: Show or hide Flo
items.body: Hold the Flo icon to hide it; tap Undo to restore it. Toggle the floating icon in Settings or Dashboard Configure.

callout.title: Naming stays inside FlowLedger
callout.body: Renaming a connected account here does not rename it at your bank.

title: Notifications and guidance
intro: Use focused reminders and the Guided Tour when you need help.

items.title: Review what needs attention
items.body: Use the alert center for bills, debts, and account items that need a decision without interrupting the rest of your day.

items.title: Open the related item
items.body: A reminder should take you directly to the bill or debt to review.

items.title: Dismiss finished work
items.body: Remove a reminder when it is complete.

items.title: Close inactive items
items.body: Paid-off or closed debts should stop creating future reminders.

items.title: Start at Step 1
items.body: The guide begins at the first section every time you open it fresh.

items.title: Follow the highlighted step
items.body: Next and Previous keep the selected tab and page in sync.

items.title: Start at the top
items.body: Every new guide page begins at the top of its content.

callout.title: Keep reminders accurate
callout.body: If a bill or debt is finished, update it so future reminders stop.

title: Settings, setup, and membership
intro: Open Settings to manage the active household, manual accounts, reminders, appearance, security, setup, and support.

items.title: Household access
items.body: Open Settings > Household to invite or join. Any member can add a nickname visible only to them. Owners and managers can also change the shared name. Dashboard’s people button switches households. All members can view shared accounts.

items.title: Bank connections
items.body: Open Settings > Bank connections to see linked accounts. New links request two months of history. Review subscription flags. Unlink disconnects all accounts at that bank and keeps past activity.

items.title: Categories and monthly budgets
items.body: In Zero-Based Budget, assign monthly income to spending, savings and debt until Left to assign is $0. Assign remaining stages an edit; Save keeps it. Choose This month only or Every month. Forecast’s Budget button opens that month.

items.title: Setup & walkthrough
items.body: Run setup again after a major change or replay the Guided Tour from its first step.

items.title: Notifications and App Lock
items.body: Choose reminders in Settings. App Lock starts Off. In Security, you can enable fingerprint or face unlock with device PIN/passcode backup, choose a delay, and use Lock now.

items.title: Help & user guide
items.body: Open this guide again or use Support when an account or plan needs help.

items.title: Free
items.body: Manual budgeting, Forecast, basic debt planning, monthly reports, sharing, customization, privacy and supported Undo stay Free.

items.title: Pro
items.body: US list prices: $9.99 monthly or $79.99 yearly per household. Pro adds saved scenarios, advanced planning, historical reports and a larger Flo allowance.

items.title: Founding Free access
items.body: Eligible existing households keep their current planning and Flo tools. Bank connections and household scenario sync retain their separate eligibility.

items.title: Verified store checkout
items.body: Purchasing opens when store products are ready. The store confirms the actual local price, eligible offer and renewal terms.

callout.title: Household and device settings
callout.body: Accounts and plan settings follow the active household. App Lock applies to your sign-in on this device.

title: Make FlowLedger yours
intro: Choose the view that helps you plan, keep amounts private, and review your latest saved changes.

items.title: Customize Dashboard
items.body: Open Customize dashboard to show, hide or reorder any card and choose up to four favorite actions. Accounts starts collapsed. Tap its header to expand or collapse balances; your choice stays saved. Reset default restores every card. Your choices are saved for you in each household.

items.title: Custom colors
items.body: Open Settings > Appearance to choose a custom app accent or calendar category color. Pick visually or enter a hex code, preview, then Apply. Colors save on this device; calendar overrides stay when you change presets.

items.title: Privacy Mode
items.body: Use the Dashboard eye or Settings > Appearance to hide amounts and Flo conversations. Show amounts restores the view. Your saved numbers and calculations stay the same.

sections.title: Personal buckets and a clear history

items.title: Personalize a bucket
items.body: Choose Personalize on a bucket card or in its details. Pick an icon, cover or photo, and turn milestone moments on if you like. Photos and bucket looks stay on this device; photos hide in Privacy Mode.

items.title: Recent Changes
items.body: Open Settings > Data & security > Recent Changes for before-and-after values and who made each change. History starts with this update. Review eligible Undo actions before confirming.

callout.title: Undo checks the latest saved version
callout.body: Some actions have linked effects and stay history-only. Use Open item to reach their existing controls. A newer edit can make an earlier change unavailable to undo.

title: When a number does not look right
intro: Most differences come from status, recurrence, unmatched activity, or an outdated balance.

items.title: 1. Refresh
items.body: Refresh the app, then confirm the manual balance and Activity are current.

items.title: 2. Check status
items.body: See whether activity is pending, posted, matched, or needs review.

items.title: 3. Check recurrence
items.body: Confirm amount, next date, and the weekly, monthly, quarterly, or other frequency.

items.title: 4. Check active state
items.body: Make sure the bill or debt is active—and close it if finished.

items.title: 5. Review Activity
items.body: Look for unmatched or duplicate-looking items before changing a balance.

items.title: 6. Verify debt details
items.body: Confirm the current balance and original minimum payment.

items.title: 7. Recheck Forecast
items.body: Open the affected day and verify the closing balance after correcting data.

items.title: Pending
items.body: Expected activity that has not fully posted or settled.

items.title: Available
items.body: The balance after relevant pending outflows.

items.title: Flow Score
items.body: A health signal based on the current FlowLedger plan.

items.title: Closing balance
items.body: For a completed day, the saved real closing balance from the latest verified account data. For a future day, the balance after scheduled activity.

callout.title: Remember the routine
callout.body: Dashboard → Next up → Activity → Forecast. If those look right, your daily review is complete.
